name: Infernity Shield Bearer
desc: Gains 800 DEF while you have no cards in your hand. You can only use each of the following effects of "Infernity Shield Bearer" once per turn. If this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Infernity" monster with 0 DEF from your hand or GY, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Synchro Monsters. You can banish this card from your GY; add 1 Level 5 or higher "Infernity" monster from your Deck or GY to your hand.
